definitions.unknownWards: Retained as a separate count; not presumed to be ordinary vision wards.
definitions.checkpoints: Nearest actual frame, for descriptive analysis only; offsetMs exposes timing error. Predictive features must use past-only frames.
definitions.soloKills: CHAMPION_KILL without registered assistingParticipantIds; agrees with challenges.soloKills in this fixture, not proof of an isolated 1v1.
definitions.deathObjectiveWindow: Opposing objective occurs in (death, death+60s]; windows can overlap and imply no causality.
definitions.objectiveGoldWindow: Last frame at/before capture versus last frame at/before capture+180s; includes activity across the map, not buff gold.
definitions.damageGoldRatio: Damage share divided by gold share; descriptive, unadjusted for champion/role.

BUILDING_KILL.backendRetention: Parsed into objective timeline, but event timeline is not saved by persistence.

CHAMPION_KILL.backendRetention: Partial: killer/victim position and timestamp; explicit linkage, assistants, bounties and death recap discarded.

ELITE_MONSTER_KILL.backendRetention: Parsed into objective timeline, but event timeline is not saved by persistence.

ITEM_PURCHASED.backendRetention: Item ID/timestamp/type stored, except purchases removed by undo handling.

ITEM_SOLD.backendRetention: Item ID/timestamp/type stored; final build mapper ignores sale effects.

ITEM_UNDO.backendRetention: Partial: beforeId/time stored and preceding buy removed; afterId/goldGain discarded.

SKILL_LEVEL_UP.backendRetention: Partial: Q/W/E/R sequence stored; timestamps and levelUpType discarded.

WARD_KILL.backendRetention: Ignored by active parser (handler has no persistence).

WARD_PLACED.backendRetention: Partial: creator-associated timestamp/type stored, including UNDEFINED; fabricated coordinates 0,0.
